summary: Findings-only code quality / architecture audit. Wrote docs/audit/v19/quality.findings.json (79 findings, all 12 schema keys, enum-valid, 0 violations; verdicts ok 36 / wrong 33 / suspect 10; severity major 24 / minor 55; basisKind internal 75 / judgment 2 / standard 2) and docs/audit/v19/quality.md (verdict-severity summary tables, the full 28-command gate sweep with exit codes and printed numbers, and per-question answers). Method: mechanical dead-export scan of 509 src symbols against src+scripts consumers; all 28 non-browser plan-S5 gates executed (25 green, 3 red); read-only node measurements of data/manifest/imaging counts; ATTRIBUTION licence check against LICENSE, the shipped licence constants and the DBCLS licence page. Headline measured results: (1) DEAD CODE - 18 exports declared and never referenced (incl. nerveCourseById and sectionImagesNearPlane, both documented as shipped APIs), SceneLayers.tsx:748 unreachable (line 736 already returns; verify:vessel-render.mjs:683 pins the dead line), the v9 stencil-era sectionCapRegistry is write-only (7 factories write, firstSectionCapColor has 0 callers), .header-presets CSS dead since v12; the two 'NOTE (orchestrator-only)' lines are honest disclaimers, not vacuous assertions. (2) CONSISTENCY - TractRecord/NerveCourseRecord/VesselCourseRecord are three parallel definitions with a comment-only superset claim (tsc still enforces it structurally); the v18 variant prop duplicates record.kind where hintForKind already derives from kind AND has zero gate references, so dropping variant='vessel' silently reverts the user-reported red-vessel defect; three near-identical course mounts in SceneLayers with two identical inlined pairing expressions. (3) TECH DEBT - plan D1 confirmed stale by measurement (verify:area-toggles exits 0 with 472 assertions in 14 groups, post-v12; every audit.mjs clickHook site is post-v12); plan D2 confirmed closed and doubly gate-guarded (area-toggles §10 non-vacuity at y=6/26/30/32, view-filter-consistency.mjs:1097); the v12g --sidebar-w gap is STILL OPEN - 320px header column vs 264px sidebar at 641-1024px = 56px drift, no gate reads the variable; D4 vessel-contour handoff open with 79 ready worker parts; D5 verify:audit-facts has no npm script, appears in no README, and is RED (49 assertions, 47 passed, 2 failed: vasc-sca-vermian-branches x=5.2 on a midline check, ctx-internal-medullary-lamina laterality record vs registry). (4) GATE QUALITY - one entry per gate with exit code and printed count; 23/32 ok. verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit CANNOT RUN (spawnSync EPERM, 0 verdicts; anatomy-qa.mjs:294 shells out to powershell for a byte total verify:budget-report already computes with fs), verify:vessel-render.mjs:1084-1094 is an if/else that only console.logs and can never fail while its PASS banner at :1271 claims the live section its own HANDOFF line contradicts, and build-anatomy-geometry.mjs --manifest rewrites the manifest it validates so a deleted GLB only warns. Named the five surfaces that would pass with the feature deleted. (5) DOCUMENTATION - 12 falsifiable README.md claims and 11 README.zh-CN.md claims resolved: 16 wrong, 8 ok. Both READMEs say 24 syndrome cards in the feature list and 26 in the content table (data: 26); both compute Structures as 264-23=241 although tracts.json has 0 id overlap with structures/*.json (264+23=287=the registry); verify:area-toggles is quoted at 331/437/455 against a measured 472 (README.md 5 occurrences, zh-CN 7); both state 40 vessel courses / 77 tubes against the gate's 41/79 (v18b added the 41st); both state the imaging payload as 7.30 MiB in 80 files under an 8 MiB cap against a measured 9.02 MiB in 82 files under the gate's 10.00 MiB cap; both state the plate split as 11/2/2 against plates.json's 10/2/3; README.md:159 understates both .bin grids 4x (238 KiB vs 956 KiB). The two READMEs have 72/72 identical headings in identical order with 179 fewer Chinese lines, so no section is missing and every stale number is shared rather than a translation gap. docs/ATTRIBUTION.md: the BodyParts3D CC BY 4.0 statement is CORRECT and was verified at the rights holder (DBCLS/LSDB licence page, attribution string quoted character-for-character at line 63) - flagged ok despite third-party mirrors still saying CC BY-SA 2.1 JP; the MIT code-licence statement matches LICENSE; every imagery family reconciles by file count (41 ubc = 17 v3 + 24 v4, 10 bmm, 3 wikict, 22 vhp); the one gap is that ATTRIBUTION.md:420 establishes provenance for 'All 12 SVG plates' under a glob that now matches 15, leaving the three v7 telencephalon plates uncovered. Verified: findings JSON parses with 79 findings, 0 schema/enum violations, and the evidence-contract command exits 0; git status --porcelain is unchanged apart from this task's two files (no product code, data, CSS or gate script edited). Cannot establish and does not claim: any browser/pixel/pointer/focus behaviour (Chrome unavailable), and one non-reproducible non-zero exit from verify:area-toggles observed under a concurrent crashing gate (recorded as suspect/minor, td-07).
